Then Hanuman, the sagacious son of Matuta, seeing Sugriva

That is why I shall delay a while so tbat he may extricate himself 
ftom this predicament by his own prowess and I shall confine 
myself to rallying the scattered forces.' 
Rellecting thus, Hanuman, hom of Matuta, sought to instil 
courage into the simian army.
